privacy.metaDescription: How {{app}} collects, uses and protects your information.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.pilotNotice: Pilot version. During the pilot, {{app}} is run by {{team}} as individuals, and they are responsible for your data. It is not yet a registered company.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal information {{app}} collects, why, who sees it, how long it is kept, and your rights under India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (DPDP Act).
privacy.dataCollectedBody:
From everyone: phone number, name, preferred language, device ID, and basic technical logs (such as IP address and app version).
From customers: service addresses and the map location you choose, bookings, quotations you approve, ratings, reviews and complaints.
From technicians: a photo of an ID document and a selfie for identity checks, the last four digits of the ID number (never the full number), skills, prices, working area and hours, profile photos, job history, ratings, and UPI or bank details if you add them for future payouts. If you use Aadhaar, upload a masked Aadhaar that shows only the last four digits.
A record of which terms you accepted, when, and from which device.
We do not collect card or bank details from customers: during the pilot no payment is made through {{app}}.
privacy.purposeBody:
To create and manage bookings and connect you with a technician · to check technicians' identity · to send sign-in codes and booking updates on WhatsApp or SMS · to keep you and others safe, prevent fraud, and look into complaints and disputes · to improve the service · where the law requires it.
We do not sell your data, and we do not use it for advertising.
privacy.sharingBody:
The other side of a booking: the technician sees your name, the service address and location, and a way to contact you, only for that job; customers see a technician's name, photo, rating and prices.
Service providers that run {{app}} for us: cloud hosting and file storage, maps and address search (OpenStreetMap), and our WhatsApp/SMS messaging provider.
The police, a court or a government authority, when the law requires it or to investigate a crime or a safety issue.
We do not share your information with anyone else.
privacy.retentionBody: We keep your account information while your account is active. Booking, complaint and terms-acceptance records are kept for up to 3 years after the booking, so that disputes and legal claims can be handled. When you ask us to delete your account, we delete your profile and personal details; records still needed for an open complaint, a dispute or a legal obligation are kept only as long as needed and then deleted.
privacy.securityBody: Sign-in uses one-time codes sent to your phone; customers and technicians have no password. Data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS). Only our team can see personal data, and only when needed. No system is completely secure; if a data breach affects you, we will inform you and the Data Protection Board as the law requires.
privacy.rightsHeading: Your rights under the DPDP Act
privacy.rightsBody: You can ask us to: tell you what data we hold about you · correct it · delete it (see the Delete Account page) · withdraw your consent (you will then no longer be able to use the service) · let someone you nominate exercise these rights for you. You can raise a grievance with us and, if you are not satisfied, with the Data Protection Board of India. Contact the grievance officer below.
privacy.childrenBody: This service is not meant for anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect children's information. If we find we have collected a minor's information by mistake, we will delete it promptly.
privacy.changesBody: If we change this policy in a meaningful way, the app will show you the new version and ask you to accept it again.

terms.metaDescription: The terms for booking a technician on {{app}} during the Jabalpur pilot.
terms.title: Terms & Conditions (Customers)
terms.pilotNotice: Pilot version. {{app}} is a trial service in Jabalpur run by {{team}} as individuals. It is not yet a registered company. When a company is formed, these terms will be updated and you will be asked to accept them again.
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use the {{app}} website or app to book a technician. When you tick "I agree" in the app, you accept these terms and our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use {{app}}.
terms.whoBody: During the pilot, {{app}} is run by {{team}} ("we", "us"), {{address}}. WhatsApp: {{whatsapp}} · Email: {{email}}.
terms.roleBody: {{app}} is a platform that connects you with independent technicians. Technicians are not our employees or agents. The technician you book does the work and is responsible for it. We help you book, keep a record of each job, and help resolve complaints.
terms.eligibilityBody: You must be 18 or older and have a valid Indian mobile number. Give us correct details, including the address where the work is to be done. You are responsible for what is done from your account, so never share your sign-in code with anyone.
terms.bookingBody: Before work starts, the technician sends a quotation in the app, and work begins only after you approve it. If extra work turns out to be needed, the technician must add it in the app with a reason, and it applies only once you approve it. Do not agree to any price outside the app. If the technician visits and you decide not to go ahead, only the visit charge shown before you booked may apply.
terms.paymentBody: During the pilot you pay the technician directly, in cash, after the job is done. {{app}} does not collect, hold or refund any money, and charges you no fee. Pay only the amount approved in the app. Nobody is authorised to collect money on behalf of {{app}}.
terms.codesBody: A job can start only when you give the technician the start code shown in your app, and it is closed with the end code. Give the start code only to the technician at your door, and the end code only when you are satisfied the work is done. Sharing a code confirms that step took place.
terms.cancellationBody: Cancelling is free until the technician has set off for your address. After that, the visit charge may apply. Repeated cancellations, or not being available at the booked time, may limit your use of {{app}}. See the Refund & Cancellation page for details.
terms.responsibilitiesBody: Keep the work area safe and reachable, tell the technician about any known hazard (such as faulty wiring or a gas leak), keep valuables away from the work area, and make sure an adult is present during the visit. Treat technicians with respect. Abuse, threats or harassment will end your account.
terms.damageBody:
If something goes wrong (poor work, damage to your property, or misbehaviour), report it within 24 hours of the job, from the booking in the app or on WhatsApp at {{whatsapp}}, with photos or video where you can. We will acknowledge it within 48 hours, check the booking record, hear both sides, and try to resolve it fairly.
A claim for damage caused by a technician is between you and that technician; we will help with the facts and the records. Theft or any other crime must be reported to the police, and we will cooperate fully with them.
terms.evidenceBody: To keep everyone safe, we keep a record of each booking: times, the quotation and your approvals, start and end codes, payment confirmations, messages and photos shared with us, and the version of these terms you accepted. You agree that these records may be used to settle complaints and disputes, and may be given to the police or a court when required.
terms.falseClaimsBody: Making a false complaint, demanding money with threats, posting false statements to harm a technician's or {{app}}'s reputation, or misusing the service can lead to your account being closed and, where the law allows, to legal action.
terms.liabilityBody: {{app}} is a pilot service, provided as it is. We check technicians' ID, but we do not run police or criminal-record checks, and we do not guarantee the quality or outcome of any work. As far as the law allows, we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss, and our total liability for any booking is limited to the amount of that booking. Nothing in these terms takes away any right you have under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 that the law does not allow to be taken away.
terms.terminationBody: You can ask us to delete your account at any time; see the Delete Account page. We may suspend or close an account that breaks these terms.
terms.changesBody: If we change these terms in a meaningful way, the app will show you the new version and ask you to accept it before you continue. The version you accepted, and when, stays on record.
terms.lawBody: These terms are governed by the laws of India. We will first try to resolve any dispute through our complaint process. If that does not work, the courts at Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh will have jurisdiction.

partnerTerms.metaDescription: The agreement for technicians working through {{app}} during the Jabalpur pilot.
partnerTerms.title: Partner Agreement (Technicians)
partnerTerms.pilotNotice: Pilot version. {{app}} is a trial service in Jabalpur run by {{team}} as individuals. It is not yet a registered company. When a company is formed, this agreement will be updated and you will be asked to accept it again.
partnerTerms.intro: This agreement applies when you use {{app}} as a technician ("partner"). When you tick "I agree" in the app, you accept this agreement and our Privacy Policy. During the pilot we may also ask you to sign a printed copy.
partnerTerms.whoBody: During the pilot, {{app}} is run by {{team}} ("we", "us"), {{address}}. WhatsApp: {{whatsapp}} · Email: {{email}}.
partnerTerms.relationshipBody: You are an independent service provider. You are not an employee, agent or franchisee of {{app}}, and this agreement does not create employment. You decide which jobs to take, and you bring your own tools and safety equipment. Materials are agreed with the customer in the quotation.
partnerTerms.eligibilityBody: You must be 18 or older, have the skills for every service you list, and show us an original government ID. During the pilot we list only technicians our team has met in person. We may decline or remove a listing at our discretion.
partnerTerms.commissionBody: During the pilot {{app}} takes 0% commission and charges you no fee. The customer pays you directly, in cash, after the job. Collect only the amount approved in the app. Never ask for extra money, and never make a tip a condition of the work. If commission is introduced later, we will tell you in advance and ask you to accept an updated agreement before it applies to any job.
partnerTerms.conductBody: Arrive on time, or tell the customer early if you will be late. Be polite and dress suitably. Never work under the influence of alcohol or drugs. Follow safe practice for electrical, gas, water and height work, and refuse any job that cannot be done safely. Do not contact a customer for anything other than their booking.
partnerTerms.processBody: Ask for the start code only when you are at the customer's address. Send the quotation, and any extra charge with a clear reason, through the app. Use the end code only when the work is finished. Take before and after photos of every job and share them with us on WhatsApp. Do not ask a customer to move a job booked on {{app}} outside the app.
partnerTerms.responsibilityBody: You are responsible for the quality of your work and for any damage, loss or injury you cause to the customer, their property or anyone else. When a customer complains, you agree to cooperate with us honestly, and to put faulty work right where that is reasonable.
partnerTerms.customerPrivacyBody: Use a customer's name, phone number and address only to do the booked job. Do not keep, share or post them, or photos of anyone's home, anywhere else.
partnerTerms.evidenceBody: We keep a record of each booking: times, quotations and approvals, start and end codes, payment confirmations, messages and photos shared with us, and the version of this agreement you accepted. You agree that these records may be used to settle complaints and disputes, and may be given to the police or a court when required.
partnerTerms.suspensionBody: We may suspend or remove you for fraud, overcharging, misconduct, unsafe work, repeated no-shows, serious or repeated complaints, or breaking this agreement. Where we can, we will tell you the reason and hear your side first. In serious cases we may suspend you at once while we look into it.
partnerTerms.liabilityBody: {{app}} does not promise any number of bookings or any level of income. As far as the law allows, we are not liable for indirect loss, or for injury or damage that happens while you are working.
partnerTerms.terminationBody: You can stop using {{app}} at any time and ask us to delete your account. A complaint about a job you have already done may still be looked into.
partnerTerms.changesBody: If we change this agreement in a meaningful way, the app will show you the new version and ask you to accept it before you continue. The version you accepted, and when, stays on record.
partnerTerms.lawBody: This agreement is governed by the laws of India. We will first try to resolve any dispute through our complaint process. If that does not work, the courts at Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh will have jurisdiction.

refund.metaDescription: How cancellation and refunds work on {{app}} during the cash-only pilot.
refund.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refund.pilotNotice: Pilot version. During the pilot, {{app}} takes no online payments: you pay the technician in cash after the job.
refund.intro: This page explains what happens if you cancel a booking, if a technician cancels, or if you are unhappy with a job.
refund.noMoneyBody: During the pilot, {{app}} does not collect any money. You pay the technician directly, in cash, only after the job is done. Because we never hold your money, there is nothing for us to refund ourselves.
refund.cancelBody: You can cancel from the booking in the app. Cancelling is free until the technician has set off for your address. If the technician has arrived and inspected the job and you decide not to go ahead, only the visit charge shown before you booked may apply.
refund.technicianCancelsHeading: If the technician cancels or does not come
refund.technicianCancelsBody: You pay nothing. Tell us from the booking or on WhatsApp ({{whatsapp}}) and we will try to find you another technician.
refund.unhappyHeading: If you are unhappy with the work or the amount
refund.unhappyBody:
Never pay more than the amount approved in the app. Report the problem within 24 hours, from the booking or on WhatsApp ({{whatsapp}}), with photos. We will check the booking record, talk to you and the technician, and help you agree a fair outcome, such as the technician coming back to fix the work or returning part of the amount.
We cannot force the return of cash paid to a technician, but a technician who does not cooperate with a fair resolution can be removed from {{app}}.
refund.futureBody: If {{app}} starts taking online payments, this policy will be updated with refund timelines before any online payment is accepted.

deleteAccount.metaDescription: How to ask {{app}} to delete your account and personal data.
deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.pilotNotice: During the pilot, accounts are deleted by our team rather than by a button in the app, so that nobody but you can have your account deleted.
deleteAccount.intro: You can ask us to delete your {{app}} account, as a customer or as a technician, at any time.
deleteAccount.howBody:
Send this message from the phone number registered on your account:
"Please delete my {{app}} account."
WhatsApp: {{whatsapp}}
Or email {{email}} with your registered phone number. We will confirm the request is really yours before deleting anything.
deleteAccount.whenBody: We will reply within 48 hours and delete your account within 7 days of confirming the request.
deleteAccount.whatBody: Your profile and name, saved addresses, photos and documents you uploaded, sign-in sessions, preferences and terms-acceptance records.
deleteAccount.keptBody: If you have an open booking, complaint or dispute, we finish handling it first. Records that the law requires us to keep, or that we need to defend a legal claim, are kept only as long as necessary and then deleted.

faq2.title: Frequently asked questions
faq2.c1q: How do I know the technician is genuine?
faq2.c1a: Our team checks every technician's ID before their profile can appear in search, and during the pilot we only list technicians we have met in person. After booking you see their name and photo, and work can only begin when you share the start code from your phone — so the person at your door is always the person you booked.
faq2.c2q: Can the price change after I book?
faq2.c2a: The rate you booked on is locked to your booking. If extra work is genuinely needed, the technician must itemise it with a written reason, and nothing proceeds until you approve the new total on screen. No surprises at the end.
faq2.c3q: What if I decide not to go ahead after the technician visits?
faq2.c3a: You only pay a small visit charge, shown to you before you ever book. The technician came, inspected and quoted — the visit charge covers that, and nothing more is owed.
faq2.c4a: In cash, directly to the technician, once you approve the work as complete. During the pilot FixBridge does not take online payments.
faq2.c5a: Raise a complaint from the booking itself. A real person on our team reviews every complaint, and serious issues suspend a technician from the platform while we investigate.
faq2.p1q: What does it cost to join?
faq2.p1a: Nothing to join or to be listed, and 0% commission during the pilot — what the customer pays is yours.
faq2.p2a: Upload your ID and documents in the app. Our team reviews them personally — usually within a few days — and your badge level rises as you complete each verification step. Higher badges rank higher in search.
faq2.p3a: During the pilot customers pay you in cash at the end of the job, so you are paid on the spot. Online payments and bank payouts will come later.
faq2.p4q: Who decides my prices and my area?
faq2.p4a: You do. Set your own rate cards, your working hours, and the radius you are willing to travel. Customers see your prices before they book, so there is no negotiation at the door.
faq2.p5a: A number built from your completed jobs, ratings and reliability — and you can see exactly how it is calculated in your dashboard. It decides your search ranking, so good work compounds.
faq2.a1a: A yearly contract for the specific machines you register — ACs, generators, motors, heavy appliances — with preventive visits on a fixed schedule, priority breakdown support, and labour covered as per your plan.
faq2.a2a: Hospitals, hotels, restaurants, factories, offices, construction sites — anywhere equipment downtime costs real money. Homes with many appliances can ask us about smaller plans.
faq2.a3q: How is it different from normal booking?
faq2.a3a: You will not have to search or book. Visits will happen on your contract calendar, and urgent faults will be handled first.
faq2.a4a: AMC is not available yet. Register your interest from this page and we will contact you when it is ready.
